title: Inspect metadata-only assemblies and handle unavailable caller information
goal: Find a metadata-only assembly's owning context, inspect nullable and constructor metadata, and report caller information with explicit deployment fallbacks.

selectionNotes: MetadataLoadContext inspection needs an untrimmed file-based CoreCLR host and explicit assembly/dependency paths; it does not execute the inspected code.
Native AOT caller inspection is a separate sample: .NET 11 needs StackTraceSupport; .NET 10 Native AOT has no equivalent. Caller identity is diagnostic, not an authorization boundary.

prerequisites: SDK console project with TargetFramework=net11.0, LangVersion=15.0, ImplicitUsings=enable and Nullable=enable. Put declarations in namespace Playbook.Samples.
Restore the declared MetadataLoadContext package; supply all inspected assembly dependency paths. Run metadata inspection in an untrimmed file-based CoreCLR process.
Native AOT publication requires a supported native compiler/linker and OS SDK. The tested Windows x64 tools and exact dependency closures are recorded per publication.
constraints: MetadataLoadContext inspection needs an untrimmed file-based CoreCLR host and explicit assembly/dependency paths; it does not execute the inspected code.

No query provider, rendering integration, external account, resource provisioning or optional workload is required. No unverified older-target route is advertised.
stabilityLimitations: Verified with .NET 11 RC2; GA reconciliation remains pending. These selected APIs have no publisher experimental annotation or required experimental opt-in.

evidence.scope: Real CoreCLR compilation/execution checks metadata-only context ownership, nullable Int32 and constructor arity, a stream-loaded assembly and process-wide logical location reporting. Untrimmed file-based host; no Native AOT or editor claims. Also executes a direct custom Type inheriting the new virtual (NotSupportedException on .NET 11) and the explicit non-nullable override; TypeDelegator is not substituted for this regression.

Each caller outcome and absent/physical location is asserted.
